# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Do not close or terminate Visual Studio during repository work; preserve the active IDE session and avoid actions that stop the coding workflow. If a file is locked, use non-destructive alternatives or ask the user to close/reload only when necessary.

## Project Guidelines
- For this compatibility update, use Hollow Knight at C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Hollow Knight and remove the invalid trailing line from Directory.Build.props.
